fields.notes: DisplayPort provides a link power-management framework (SET_POWER D0/D3 over DPCD; eDP Panel Replay / PSR). The AUX channel is the wake and management path. Detailed rail/domain power is a Source/Sink silicon concern; the spec defines the protocol-level power states.

link_power_management_states.name: Active
link_power_management_states.description: Main Link trained and streaming video; AUX available.

link_power_management_states.name: Low power
link_power_management_states.description: Sink/Source powered down via SET_POWER DPCD = D3; Main Link idle; AUX wakes it.

link_power_management_states.name: Panel self-refresh
link_power_management_states.description: eDP panel holds a static frame from its own memory; the Main Link can quiesce.

power_rails.purpose: Auxiliary 3.3 V (e.g. for AUX / dongle / branch device).

fields.displayport_power_considerations: DisplayPort manages power via the SET_POWER DPCD register (D0 active / D3 low-power) and, for eDP, Panel Self-Refresh / Panel Replay that let the panel hold a static frame so the Main Link can quiesce. The AUX channel stays available to wake the link. UHBR rates trade higher bandwidth for higher PHY power; FEC adds modest overhead.
